newsitem.title: JAPAN: Alcan, Nippon Light Metal form Asia ventures.
newsitem.headline: Alcan, Nippon Light Metal form Asia ventures.

text.p: Alcan Aluminium Ltd and Nippon Light Metal Co (NLM) said on Wednesday they had formed a holding company and a management company for their joint ventures in Southeast Asia and China.

The move follows their announcement in July that they would restructure their holdings in Japan and Asia and that Alcan would acquire a 60 percent share in Asian subsidiaries that several years earlier had been transferred to NLM's ownership.
Alcan Pacific Ltd vice president Glenn Lucas said then that Alcan intended to take a more hands-on role in Southeast Asia and China and to expand its operations there.
Alcan holds a 47 percent share in NLM, one of Japan's leading aluminium producers and fabricators.
Alcan and NLM announced on Wednesday they had set up Alcan Nikkei Asia Holdings Ltd (ANAH) as a regional holding company for their shares in joint ventures in Malaysia, Thailand and China.
A second company, Alcan Nikkei Asia Co (ANAC), was created as a regional management company to provide overall direction for ANAH's companies.
ANAC will have an operating office in Kuala Lumpur and will be headed by Lucas.
